title: An NSGo package or plugin, one file per package named after its slug

mark.description: One or two letters for the card.

official.description: true for a package inside NSGo's own module, github.com/oneo-me/nsgo, whose import then starts with github.com/oneo-me/nsgo/; community packages are false.

surface.description: The kind of app it serves: Go apps, TSX apps, or both.

import.description: The Go package the app imports, such as github.com/oneo-me/nsgo/base/datatable.

npm.description: An npm package the plugin comes with. NSGo compiles TSX with no Node, so its own packages have none.
